review: Read all250lines. Findings below are logical contract counterexamples, not execution or native evidence.

findings.reason: Timestamp after send_init returns is an upper bound on stdin closure, not a lower bound on child idle start. Fence can allow natural idle exit0 as EOF.
findings.required: Use trusted timestamp before send_init call or a pinned conservative pre-close lower bound. Fence must never move later due a delayed return.

findings.reason: Post-return check only fence ignores the earlier min(t_eof+10,fence) wait deadline. A callback returning late can still PASS.
findings.required: Capture absolute wait_end once, require current time strictly before both phase end and idle fence before accepting. Same post-return opening checks for all fallible phase calls.

findings.reason: Popen(stdin=PIPE) allocates unregistered pipe descriptors inside spawn, contrary to ownership before Popen. Unknown process slot is conservative retention but not prior fd ownership.
findings.required: Design explicit pre-owned stdin pipe, smallest additional System pipe primitive/slots, exact stdin=read_fd and inheritance/closure ordering. Process gap remains UNKNOWN and fail-closed. No SDK/private-fd API change by assumption.

findings.reason: A read-only endpoint facade is a trusted code contract, not physical inability of hostile Python to send.
findings.required: Scope statement to reviewed binding/no send operation, retain Python-trust qualification.
